agent.network: disabled for model download requirements and isolated public-test/grader candidate executions
agent.public_test: syntax-only AST parse; a successful result is not semantic evidence.
agent.tool_interface: list_files, read_file (maximum 80 inclusive lines), search_text, apply_patch, check_syntax, run_public_tests, finish

grader.calibration_result: PASS: pinned baseline fails, exact fix passes, six task cases match exactly, six meaningful mutants rejected, red-team suite passes.

hypothesis: On this Development-only repository repair task, at least one of two bounded Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit attempts will produce a candidate patch accepted by the calibrated independent grader.

model.license: Qwen Research License Agreement; non-commercial research/evaluation use only

null_hypothesis: Neither attempt produces an independently accepted repair.

primary_outcome.success_definition: The exact candidate source bytes pass all six parent-owned expected-output cases in the pinned v3 grader.

reproduction.command_template: python scripts/monitor_local_agent_resources_v2.py --output <new-attempt-dir> --max-seconds 180 --swap-abort-mib <min(4096, attempt-start-swap+128)> --memory-free-abort-percent 35 --rss-abort-mib 8192 -- python scripts/run_local_agent.py --workspace <prepared-workspace> --model-path <locked-local-snapshot> --model-repository mlx-community/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit --backend mlx --public-test-image <locked-image> --task-root results/transformers-45852-qwen25-3b-agent-feasibility-v1/task-input --output <attempt-dir>/agent-run.json --instruction <locked-user-message> --seed <locked-seed> --max-turns 12 --max-no-tool-retries 1 --max-new-tokens-per-turn 256 --max-total-new-tokens 2048 --max-context-tokens 6144 --wall-seconds 180 --temperature <locked-temperature> --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 --<locked-sampling-flag> --edit-format unified_diff
reproduction.grading: Use only work/transformers45852-grader-v3 at exact commit b9f5dd6b32bacad026b87a5fed43dac2108e142a; run verify_protocol(), export_baseline() from work/transformers45852-baseline-v3, copy only candidate target bytes, then grade_workspace() with the locked v3 image.

resources.hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB unified memory, CPU and available Metal acceleration
resources.maximum_local_compute_budget: Two model loads, two attempts, at most 360 aggregate agent wall seconds; no paid APIs, rented GPUs, or training.

scope: Single-task model feasibility only; no training, policy update, optimizer step, held-out evaluation, or learning claim.
stopping_rule: Run exactly one greedy and one sampled attempt. Abort before or during an attempt on any frozen resource/provenance limit. Do not repeat either attempt or use this task for held-out evaluation.

task.agent_workspace: Pinned src/transformers package at baseline plus TASK.md and operator-authored syntax-only test_public.py; no upstream tests, Git history, network, or grader files exposed through agent tools.
